post.summary: CreateRule creates alerting rule from the given template.

params.description: Rule parameters. All template parameters should be set.

items.description: ParamValue represents a single rule parameter value.

name.description: Machine-readable name (ID) that is used in expression.

severity.description: Severity represents severity level of the check result or alert.

custom_labels.description: All custom labels to add or remove (with empty values) to default labels from template.

items.description: Filter represents a single filter condition.

rule_id.description:
Identifier PMM assigns to a rule whose thresholds can be overridden per target.
Empty when the rule has no overridable parameters, since nothing can be keyed on it.
This is the rule's identity for threshold purposes rather than its Grafana UID:
copying or renaming the rule in Grafana preserves it.

get.summary: ListTemplates returns a list of all collected alert rule templates.

parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Index of the requested page, starts from 0.
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.description: If true, template files will be re-read from disk.
parameters.name: reload

items.description: Template represents Alert Template that is used to create Alert Rule.

expr.description: PromQL query expression with templating parameters.

items.description: ParamDefinition represents a single query parameter.

name.description: Machine-readable name (ID) that is used in expression.

unit.description:
ParamUnit represents template parameter unit.

 - PARAM_UNIT_UNSPECIFIED: Invalid, unknown or absent.
 - PARAM_UNIT_PERCENTAGE: %
 - PARAM_UNIT_SECONDS: s

bool.description: BoolParamDefinition represents boolean parameter's default value.

float.description: FloatParamDefinition represents float parameter's default value and valid range.

string.description: StringParamDefinition represents string parameter's default value.

overridable.description:
Whether this parameter's threshold can be overridden per target without editing the
rule. Only set for templates that support it; the scopes it may be set at are
reported per rule by ListThresholds.

severity.description: Severity represents severity level of the check result or alert.

source.description:
TemplateSource defines template source.

 - TEMPLATE_SOURCE_BUILT_IN: Template that is shipped with PMM Server releases.
 - TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SAAS: Template that is downloaded from check.percona.com.
 - TEMPLATE_SOURCE_USER_FILE: Templated loaded from user-suplied file.
 - TEMPLATE_SOURCE_USER_API: Templated created via API.

created_at.description: Template creation time. Empty for built-in and SaaS templates.

yaml.description: YAML template file content. Empty for built-in and SaaS templates.

queries.description: PromQL query steps for multi-query templates. Empty for single-expression templates.

items.description: TemplateQuery represents a PromQL query step in a multi-query alert template.

expr.description: PromQL query expression with templating parameters (placeholders kept intact).

expressions.description: Server-side expression steps for multi-query templates. Empty for single-expression templates.

items.description: TemplateExpression represents a server-side expression step in a multi-query alert template.

type.description: Expression type. Currently only "math" is supported.

expression.description: Expression body referencing other steps by ref ID (e.g. "$A > $B").

condition.description: Reference ID of the step used as the alert condition (e.g. "C"). Empty for single-expression templates.

put.summary: UpdateTemplate updates existing template, previously created via API.

delete.summary: DeleteTemplate deletes existing, previously created via API.

parameters.description:
Scope of the target to report thresholds for. Must be set together with target.

 - THRESHOLD_SCOPE_NODE: Target is a Node ID.
 - THRESHOLD_SCOPE_SERVICE: Target is a Service ID.
 - THRESHOLD_SCOPE_CLUSTER: Target is a cluster label value.
parameters.name: scope

parameters.description:
Target to report thresholds for. When set, every overridable parameter is returned
for that target, overridden or not. When empty, only existing overrides are
returned, since there is otherwise no bounded set to enumerate.
parameters.name: target

parameters.description: Return only thresholds of this rule.
parameters.name: rule_id

items.description: Threshold is one overridable parameter of one rule, as it applies to one target.

rule_id.description:
Identifier PMM assigned to the rule. Not unique within a response: rules duplicated
in Grafana share it, so two entries can carry the same rule_id and param_name and
differ only in which rule they came from. Do not key a map on it.

param_name.description: Machine-readable name of the overridable parameter.

summary.description: Short human-readable parameter summary, as it was when the rule was created.

unit.description:

 - PARAM_UNIT_PERCENTAGE: %
 - PARAM_UNIT_SECONDS: s

default_value.description: Value the rule falls back to when no override applies.

effective_value.description: Value the rule currently evaluates this target against.

is_overridden.description: Whether effective_value comes from an override rather than the default.

 - THRESHOLD_SCOPE_CLUSTER: Target is a cluster label value.
